# ST Engineering and RTX’s Collins Aerospace Deepen Collaboration on Aircraft Component Support


September 16, 2026


- Share this article on Facebook
- Share this article on Twitter
- Share this article on LinkedIn
- Share this article via email


***Singapore, 23 September 2026*** - ST Engineering’s Commercial Aerospace business and Collins Aerospace, an RTX business, today announced the signing of three multi-year agreements that build on their longstanding working relationship to enhance component support for airline operators.


These agreements mark a new collaboration on component repairs and extend existing arrangements for spare parts procurement and lifecycle repairs. Together, they enable ST Engineering and Collins to integrate original equipment manufacturing (OEM) and maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) expertise, providing airline operators with reliable, fast-turnaround component repairs to meet aircraft dispatch needs.


The agreements cover three areas of collaboration:


- **New Boeing 787 component repair support**
ST Engineering will provide repair services for Collins fan assembly electronics boards used on the 787. The cooperation agreement reduces Line Replaceable Unit (LRU) repair turnaround times and improve efficiency through repair-over-replacement solutions for airlines and operators.
- **Broader OEM spare parts support**
ST Engineering extended and expanded a multi-platform agreement to procure new Power & Controls spare parts from Collins for its LRU component MRO operations. The broader scope adds more narrowbody aircraft components to ST Engineering’s portfolio for enhanced OEM-standard component repair support.
- **Continued lifecyle repair support for Airbus A320 and Boeing 737 LRUs**
ST Engineering and Collins extended their collaboration on A320 and 737 family LRU component repairs through Collins’ aftermarket support programme, FlightSense™.


“Our longstanding relationship with Collins Aerospace brings together its OEM expertise and ST Engineering’s lifecycle MRO and comprehensive asset management strengths to better support airline operators worldwide,” said Poon Kok Wah, SVP and Head of Component Services at ST Engineering. “The expanded scope of these agreements deepens our collaboration and enhances the value of our Maintenance-By-the-Hour™ programme, in-house component MRO capabilities for the 787, 737 MAX and A320neo and distribution and material services. Together, these capabilities provide customers with broader repair coverage, reliable component support and responsive lifecycle solutions.”


"Expanding our collaboration with ST Engineering allows us to better support the aviation ecosystem with agile and high-standard MRO solutions," said Jen Latka, vice president of Aftermarket, Power & Controls, Collins Aerospace. "These lifecycle and repair programmes ensure that operators worldwide benefit from maximised component efficiency and enhanced fleet performance."


[ST Engineering](https://www.stengg.com/) is a global technology, defence and engineering group with a diverse portfolio of businesses across the aerospace, smart city, defence and public security segments. The Group harnesses technology and innovation to solve real-world problems, enabling a more secure and sustainable world. Headquartered in Singapore, it has operations spanning Asia, Europe, the Middle East and the U.S., serving customers in more than 100 countries. ST Engineering reported revenue of over S$12b in 2025 and ranks among the largest companies listed on the Singapore Exchange. It is a component stock of MSCI Singapore, FTSE Straits Times Index and Dow Jones Best-in-Class Asia Pacific Index.


Follow[ST Engineering on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/st-engineering) .


**Collins Aerospace** , an RTX business, provides advanced aerospace and defense solutions across avionics, aircraft interiors, aerostructures and engine components, mission systems, and power and control systems. Our global employees are dedicated to delivering innovative technologies to enhance aircraft performance, passenger comfort, operational safety and reliability.
